candidate.title: MeRIP-Seq/m6A-seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina single-route schematic grouped under MeRIP-Seq/m6A-seq: biological RNA context, extraction, the captioned Fractionate RNA transition, m6A-directed immunoprecipitation, and reverse transcription ending in cDNA. The two names are retained as separately associated reports within the shared antibody-enrichment/sequencing architecture, without asserting complete protocol equivalence. Repeated context cartoons are not separate experimental branches. The image stops at cDNA; the catalogue-described sequencing explains its readout role. Similar methods, associated kit lists, viral applications and computational protocols do not expand the targets. The shared title does not by itself establish that the two publication-specific method names are exact aliases.

operations.label: Extract RNA
operations.description: Recover RNA from the biological context as an extracted RNA population; the long marked RNA is carried into the fragment-generation step.
operations.information_effect: Transfers the target-bearing RNA into the assay. The context RBP is not carried as the readout analyte.

operations.label: Fractionate RNA
operations.description: Convert the extracted long RNA into a mixed population of shorter RNA fragments. The visible length change is interpreted as fragmentation, as explicitly reported for MeRIP-Seq by Meyer et al.; the source caption is retained.
operations.mechanism: RNA fragmentation; no end chemistry or execution conditions are specified here.
operations.information_effect: Retains local RNA sequence and any m6A sites within each fragment, while losing the intact transcript as the captured unit. Selection will therefore localize enriched regions at fragment scale.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate
operations.description: Use antibodies to select m6A-bearing RNA fragments from the fragmented mixture. The antibody-contact intermediate and the following antibody-free marked fragments are represented as selection and recovery within this one schematic operation.

operations.information_effect: Introduces the association between retained RNA sequences and m6A-directed antibody enrichment. Unmarked fragments are no longer shown on the retained route; no separate flow-through branch is drawn. Specificity is limited by antibody cross-reactivity.
